messages:
Ana: Quick check — proposing a short daily 'sunset shift' triage sync Mon–Fri at 19:45 PT (15m) to formalize handoffs and confirm escalation attendance. Draft agenda below. Can people confirm availability or volunteer for escalation coverage? If you can't make it, react :x: and leave a note.

Ana: Agenda (draft):
```
- 19:45 - quick rollcall (2m)
- open incidents status (5m) — owners give 1-line of current state
- recent alerts/false-positives (3m)
- handoff checklist + next steps (3m)
- volunteers for escalation & shadowing notes
```

Ben: I'm +1 for a daily slot but 19:30 would be easier on Tue/Thu for me. Can we try 19:45 for a week and see how it goes? :thumbsup:

Chloe: 19:45 works most days. I can take Tue/Thu escalation for the next two weeks. Will mark in calendar.

Michael: I can cover Mon/Wed. Propose we add a rotating "incident owner" assignment in the calendar invite so it's clearer who owns the next 24h. Also would be good to surface any ongoing rollout that might affect latency.

Ravi: Happy to be backup for nights this week if needed. Which incidents should we prioritize tomorrow?

Ana: Right now the list I'm tracking: inc-2026-38 (KV cache evictions causing transient 5xxs), inc-2026-39 (Dedicated pool OOM on batch infer nodes), inc-2026-40 (latency spike in eu-west-1 during a canary). Please call out any others.

DevOpsBot: Deployment prod/model-bundle-1.14 completed at 19:12 PT — smoke checks passed. :robot_face:

Sara: Quick ask — can we add the pre-handoff checklist link to the invite? https://intra.redwood/handbooks/oncall/handoff-checklist — includes runbook snippets and pager flow. Also, Ben can you ping the paging list if you take escalation?

Ben: Yep, will ping the paging list when I take Tue/Thu. Done for Chloe's Tue slot too.

Chloe: One more thing — for the 'open incidents' item, let's cap each update to one sentence + owner. Keeps the meeting tight.

Michael: Agreed. Suggest trial for 2 weeks, then gather feedback in #eng-oncall. If the daily cadence is heavy, we can collapse to weekdays only and/or 3x/week.

Ana: Thanks — I'll send a calendar invite for a trial starting tomorrow, include the checklist link and a rotating owner. If you want specific days off the rotation, DM me.

Ravi: +1, I'll be on backup Thu/Fri next week.

Sara: Acked and added checklist to my calendar. :white_check_mark:

Ana: Perfect — see you all at 19:45 PT. If anything urgent before then, drop it in this thread or page the oncall list.
